font.reason: Review found Markazi Text rendered monoline and sans-like and too light against the heavy Georgia 600 lockup. Amiri is a genuine high-contrast Naskh serif, so the editorial voice is visible. It has one weight, so heaviness is rebuilt with a 2.5px ink text stroke instead of synthesized bold. Kicker keeps Vazir Code for the console cadence.

comps.translatedSummary: Wordmark «آزمایشگاه هوش مصنوعی», kicker «کنسول پژوهشی تیم».

rtlDecisions.why: Per-unit motion runs on joinedGroups so letters keep joining; row is rtl so the first group is right-most and stamping goes right to left. The delay step is derived so the last unit starts at the original f58 and finishes at f70, keeping the 1s hold (f67-97) and exit unchanged.

Prefix slice via typeOn, growing from the right edge. The block cursor sits at the logical end (left) via marginInlineStart. Speed rescaled to the original f28-f43 window; letterSpacing and uppercase removed.
Line endpoints swapped so the pen starts at the right end, the reading-start side. Same frames and easing.

rtlDecisions.what: Crosshair vertical stroke, glint underline, lift/shrink exit, centered composition
rtlDecisions.why: Symmetric or physical vertical motion with no reading-direction meaning.
fs() x1.1, wordmark lineHeight 1.3, kicker box scaled for Persian ascenders and dots.
Markazi to Amiri with 2.5px stroke to restore the heavy serif lockup; no motion or timing change.

concerns: Persian wordmark has 20 units against the original 17 glyphs, so the stagger step is about 2.4f instead of 3f to keep the original end beat.

Glint underline bottom moved from -6 to 14 so it sits just under the Persian descenders (lineHeight 1.3 made it float). Dead perChar variable removed. Wordmark weight is a stroke approximation of the original 600 serif.
